note: The beachcomber's trail (doc 13 'Trails', docs/future/12), read by src/world/expansion.js. A stop is a first, never a total; for now the stops count keepsake families ever kept (the saved unlocks' kept list: letting one go never takes a family back). At a stop's mark (at: families kept) the island gives it once, for good: give is merged into the saved unlocks (nets.general: the general net, and the Net chip under the Water tool). A stop with no give is not built yet and gives nothing (the shelf comes with the shells today; the glass case, the light and sinker nets, the second shelf and the rest wait for their pieces). title and line are the card and its journal note; icon is drawn from src/ui/icons. The Trails page that draws this line is a later piece.

a way to reach the sea
stops.title: You can weave a net
stops.line: Rushes and patience. Look for Net under Water, and cast it in the shallows at low tide.
